newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-CLINTON CONGRATULATES PACKERS ON SUPER BOWL VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-CLINTON CONGRATULATES PACKERS ON SUPER BOWL VICTORY.

text.p: President Clinton telephoned the Green Bay Packers late Sunday night to congratulate the team on its 35-21 victory over the New England Patriots in Super Bowl XXXI in New Orleans.

Clinton reached Packers' coach Mike Holmgren and told him "the team did a superb job throughout the game, although the Patriots didn't let them off easy," said White House spokeswoman Kathleen McKiernan.
The president also spoke with the game's MVP, Desmond Howard, and quarterback Brett Favre.
Clinton told Howard that "although he had had a rough year, he really showed everyone what he was made of in tonight's game," McKiernan said.
Howard had a record-setting day, including a spectacular 99-yard kick return for a touchdown.
Clinton watched the game while enjoying pizza with a group of lawmakers in the White House's family theatre, which features a big screen television and looks like a small movie theatre.
